experience.title: A historic place in the heart of Limone
experience.text: The story of Incontro is rooted in the history of Limone sul Garda. Set among the historic terraces of the village, this place connects the character of the past with the pleasure of Italian dining today. The lake, the mountains and the traditional architecture of Limone create a setting where history remains part of the experience — alongside good food, wine and hospitality.

moments.title: Memories made at Incontro
moments.description: A family lunch, a toast with friends, a sunset dinner or a selfie by the lake — moments our guests choose to remember.
moments.footer: Every table has a story. Every visit leaves a memory.

cuisine.title: Italian cuisine with a taste of Lake Garda
cuisine.description: At Ristorante Pizza Incontro, Italian cuisine meets the flavours of Lake Garda. The menu brings together fresh fish and seafood, homemade pasta, carefully prepared meat dishes and authentic Italian pizza. From Garda char and risotto with scallops to handmade mezzelune, beef tartare and the signature Pizza Incontro, each dish is prepared with attention to detail. A carefully selected wine list completes the experience, from Italian classics to prestigious labels.
